name: Article 1 – § 1 – point 1; Directive 2003/87/EC – Article 10a – § 2a – sub§ 2 – 9
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Directive 2003/87/EC as regards revised benchmark values for the heat and fuel benchmarks for the period from 2026 to 2030
part_text: Notwithstanding paragraph 2, third subparagraph, points (c) and (d), of this Article, the Commission shall set the benchmark values used to calculate free allocation based on the heat and fuel benchmarks for the year 2026 at the level of the corresponding benchmark values that applied for the period from 2021 to 2025. Within three months of the entry into force of this Regulation, the Commission shall adopt the implementing acts necessary for the application of this subparagraph in accordance with paragraph 2 of this Article and, where necessary, amend the relevant acts in accordance with paragraph 5 of this Article and Article 11(3). Member States shall recalculate the free allocation for 2026 on this basis. If the recalculated quantity exceeds the quantity already allocated free of charge, the difference shall be granted together with the free allocation for 2027. Allocations already made in accordance with the law shall remain unaffected. The recovery of allowances solely on the basis of this recalculation is excluded. The data already available shall be used for the recalculation, to the extent that such data is sufficient.
